summary: One coordinated toolbar for all main-chat selections, including cross-message excerpts. All vendor bytes remain hash-pinned.

edits.why: This is the merge: instead of moving two plugins' floating boxes together, the annotation toolbar — one hover box — renders an extra button per action the merged bundle injects. The 引用 button then drives dsh-quote-followup's own insert path. The injected loop is wrapped so a throwing action cannot abort the whole toolbar render.

edits.why: Capture the selection API belonging to this mount so a retired annotation instance cannot clear its successor.
Use one scope policy for all actions. Reject file previews, editable controls and any sidebar before accepting legacy row markers; cross-message selections use the transcript as their root.

Render the same three-action toolbar for single/cross-message selections. Synchronize excerpt, root, anchor, button admission and geometry in the selection turn; no settle or global 80ms ignore window.
Position from the current selection snapshot, not a search for the first identical excerpt in another message; streaming recovery re-anchors inside the selected root.
Annotate the validated snapshot, including a cross-message excerpt or a saved streaming excerpt; never fall back to text from a cancelled selection.
edits.find:
function enterEditing() {
        ui.mode = 'editing'
        ui.noteDraft = ''
        ui.error = null
        ui.editingId = null
        ui.pendingAnchor = captureAnchor(ui.quote)
        render()
      }

edits.why: Closing the toolbar also clears the saved quote and shared snapshot, with ownership checks across hot replacement.
Allow the coordinator and successful quote action to close the single toolbar.

Keep the pending-annotation chip in a reserved row inside the composer seat. Preserve an existing tail landing when it first grows and settle geometry after host layout, without pulling history readers to the bottom. Cancel deferred work and release owned padding on hide, session change, composer replacement and disposal.
Restore the composer padding when annotation is disposed so disabling or replacing the merged plugin never leaves unused space in the host.
